title: MJF & Adam Cole: Better Than You Bay Bay to the Devil
summary: An unlikely friendship and tag team masks the betrayal behind MJF’s downfall.

chapters.title: Partners and opponents at Wembley
chapters.result: MJF and Cole win the ROH tag titles; MJF later retains his world title against Cole.
chapters.context: Their friendship survives a night of competing ambitions.

chapters.title: The Devil is revealed
chapters.result: After Joe defeats MJF, Cole is revealed as the Devil behind the masked attackers.
chapters.context: The apparent friendship ends in an organized betrayal.
